class.name: DSPackScanner
class.brief_description: Native byte-pattern scanner for exported Godot pack verification.
class.description: Provides a native fast path for [code]dspkg_pack_scan_core.gd[/code] to search exported [code].pck[/code] files and raw byte buffers for the derived key-file magic without per-chunk GDScript allocations.

method.name: buffer_contains_bytes
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param needle] occurs anywhere inside [param haystack].

method.name: file_contains_bytes
method.description: Scans [param path] in 4 MiB chunks using a single reusable buffer and returns a dictionary with keys [code]ok[/code] ([bool]), [code]found[/code] ([bool]), and [code]size[/code] ([int]).
